description: Source code for the Forgotten account controller class in OpenCart, handling forgotten password functionality including index, confirm, reset, and password methods.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class managing the forgotten password process in the account namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the forgotten password form, redirects logged-in users to account page.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes the forgotten password confirmation, verifies email and code, resets token if valid.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles resetting the password, validating reset token and email, and providing a form for password change.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Processes changing the password, validating password requirements, confirmation, and updating customer data.
